name: Berry Chia Parfait
steps: Whisk the chia seeds into the milk with the vanilla extract. Let sit 5 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (or overnight) until it sets into a pudding-like texture.
Layer the chia pudding with Greek yogurt and mixed berries in jars or glasses.
Drizzle with honey. Keeps 4-5 days refrigerated — assemble the fruit layer fresh each morning if you prefer it less soggy.
notes: Frozen berries work well and are more budget-friendly for a full week's batch.
